description: This Java class handles encryption and decryption of database passwords, including generating password hashes and validating master passwords. It also contains a main method for command-line password encryption.

classes.name: DatabasePasswordEncryptor
classes.description: A component class that provides password encryption, decryption, hashing, and validation functionalities for database passwords within the Fineract project.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Command-line utility to encrypt a password and display its hash using a master password.

methods.name: encrypt
methods.description: Encrypts a plaintext password using the configured master password and encryption method.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted password back to plaintext using the configured master password and encryption method.

methods.name: getMasterPasswordHash
methods.description: Generates a hash of the master password for validation purposes.

methods.name: getPasswordHash
methods.description: Generates a bcrypt hash of the provided master password.

methods.name: isMasterPasswordHashValid
methods.description: Validates a given hash against the current master password.
